text:
Maya (Marketing): quick heads-up — Q3 launch post metrics are in. dashboard looks noisy, want to sync on attribution window & lead routing before we publish the recap.
Lucas (Growth): saw the spike in signups after the webinar, but conversions dropped in the inbound flow. could be UTM mapping or landing redirect.
Priya (Analytics): I pulled the cohort view — initial session -> signup -> qualified. 7-day vs 30-day attribution changes numbers a lot. sharing link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/q3-launch-cohort (refresh at 11:05am).
Omar (Sales Ops): FYI sales ops sees ~18% uplift in MQLs from the webinar list, but lead scoring flags 40% as unknown source. routing rules might be losing utm_source.
Elena (PMM): are we prioritizing engagement (webinar attendees) or new organic signups for the postmortem narrative? we need one canonical story for the exec slide.
Priya (Analytics): quick snapshot: 7-day convo rate = 4.1%, 30-day convo rate = 6.9%. If we use 7-day we underreport the webinar effect. recommend 30-day for launch narrative, but keep 7-day in appendix.
Lucas (Growth): +1 to 30-day for the headline. but we should call out the gating: redistributions from paid channels after Day 3.
Maya (Marketing): ok 30-day headline. next: attribution mapping — Priya, can you confirm which utm parameters are getting dropped?
Priya (Analytics): short answer: utm_campaign is fine; utm_medium sometimes rewritten by the redirector on /signup. here's the quick SQL I used:
```
SELECT utm_source, COUNT(distinct user_id) AS signups
FROM events
WHERE event = 'signup' AND created_at >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY utm_source
ORDER BY signups DESC
```
The redirector is rewriting utm_medium to 'referral' for some paths.
Omar (Sales Ops): that explains the unknown-source bucket. patch suggestion: keep utm parameters in the final redirect or append original params as _orig_utm_* fields.
Maya (Marketing): actionables: 1) Priya to update dashboard to show both 7d/30d side-by-side + add a note about redirect behavior. 2) Eng infra to fix redirector (Omar to coordinate). 3) Lucas to draft the exec headline using 30-day metric and appendix with 7-day. 4) Elena to write the messaging blurb for the launch post.
Lucas (Growth): I'll draft the exec bullet. any constraints on numbers? need to include raw sample sizes.
Priya (Analytics): sample sizes: webinar attendees = 3,412; tracked signups (30d) = 238; tracked signups (7d) = 142. will add these under each metric.
Maya (Marketing): perfect. timeline: can we get dashboard updates and redirect patch by Monday EOD?
Priya (Analytics): yes — dashboard update by Monday 10am.
Omar (Sales Ops): I'll open the ticket with eng infra now and ping @eng-oncall.
Elena (PMM): I'll have the messaging drafts by Monday noon, will include CTA variants for A/B testing.
Lucas (Growth): should we add a quick A/B test for the landing copy for the next 72 hours to validate the conversion delta?
Maya (Marketing): yes, but small: variant A = current, B = webinar-highlight. Omar — can you ensure routing keeps test traffic separate?
Omar (Sales Ops): yep, will append test param and route to test queue.
Maya (Marketing): dash-bot — can you post a weekly KPI snapshot in #marketing every Monday and include the 7d/30d split for launch cohorts?
dash-bot: Scheduled report created. First run: 2026-08-03 09:00 PST. Report includes: overall signups, conversion (7d/30d), MQLs, top utm_sources.
Lucas (Growth): great. final ask — Priya, please add a one-paragraph caveat about attribution window choice for the exec deck.
Priya (Analytics): will do.
Maya (Marketing): thanks everyone. follow-up doc: https://redwood.app/docs/launch-postmortem/q3-signal-handoff — I'll populate once we have the numbers and the redirect ticket link. :thumbsup:
